items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-08-31
items.q: [SPEAKER_03] My name is Paul Crawford and I'll ask the interviewer and the interviewee to introduce themselves.

ctx.x: This is an interview being recorded in the Seminar Room 2 of the Howard-Chilton Memorial Library at Tulane University. The day is August 31, 1962. My name is Paul Crawford and I'll ask the interviewer and the interviewee to introduce themselves.
My name is William R. Hogan and I'm here mostly listening to Bill Russell.
